description: S08 recovery constants. Method definitions only — the P0/P1 experiment-cell registry is S09's.

recovery_version.note: Bumped whenever executable recovery semantics change; it enters every recovery artifact identity.

arithmetic_dtype.note: 01 §10 merge/recovery arithmetic and 00 §25 P0-C1 ('compute in float32'). Every scientific recovered artifact is float32.

diagnostic_dtype.note: 01 §10 metrics/statistics: derived scalar quantities are stored in float64. Evaluation accumulates in float64 because it does not define artifact bytes.

svd_workspace_dtype.note: 01 §10. The truncated-SVD workspace runs in float64 for stability; every reconstruction is deterministically cast to the arithmetic dtype before it re-enters the iteration or is hashed.

svd_backend.note: 01 §12. Pinned so the C2 iteration is reproducible. LAPACK's divide-and-conquer driver (gesdd, what numpy calls) fails to converge on some ill-conditioned residual iterates the C2 core reaches; the QR-iteration driver (gesvd) succeeds on the same matrix. The escalation is deterministic and mathematically equivalent - it computes the SVD of the same matrix - and it never runs unless the primary raises, so every path that already converges keeps its exact bytes. Rank and truncation semantics are unchanged.

c2_method.note: 00 §25 P0-C2 'Spectral-DeTuning-style shared-source / low-rank-residual baseline'. Alternating common-source / truncated-SVD residual core, implemented independently from the mathematical description. Reproduction baseline, not a novelty contribution.

c2_method_version.note: C2B and O3 recovery bind this exact solver version; they introduce no second optimizer.

c2_n_iters.note: IMPLEMENTATION_ADJUDICATION_PRE_DATA. 00 §25 does not freeze convergence internals; the reference implementation's SFT/DPO examples use n_iters=1000. A fixed count avoids a result-dependent stopping rule [AUTH: 00 §34B.1A; 01 §29].

c2_rank_scheduler.note: IMPLEMENTATION_ADJUDICATION_PRE_DATA. The residual rank is known from the controlled LoRA/O3 construction, and no scheduler policy was frozen in the measurement spec, so the published adaptive scheduler is not part of the primary S08 path.

linear_residual_rank.note: 00 §8.3 / 01 §8B primary LoRA rank r = 32. The C2 residual rank for standard linear descendants. For O3 the residual rank is the retained rank s carried by the observation, never a caller choice.

conditioning_numerical_rank_tolerance.note: IMPLEMENTATION_ADJUDICATION_PRE_DATA. 00 §26 requires a fixed numerical-rank tolerance without repeating its value; this reuses the already-frozen 00 §24A.6 criterion sigma_j / sigma_1 >= 1e-6 rather than inventing a second tolerance.

c1_pass_criterion_ef.note: 00 §25 P0-C1 pass criterion e_F <= 1e-5, evaluated in float32. Owned by the evaluator; the solver never sees it.

partner_norm_match_limit.note: 00 §25 P0-C2B.2 partner-norm matching guard. Experiment-construction and evaluation only; a recovery method may never use it to search or select partners.

c2b_k2_reference_schedule.note: 00 §25 P0-C2B.1 k = 2 reference schedule; beta spread ~3.45, a_alpha ~2.86.

c2b_k4_spread_matched_schedule.note: 00 §25 P0-C2B.1 k = 4 spread-matched schedule; beta spread matched to k = 2.

c2b_k4_wide_schedule.note: 00 §25 P0-C2B.1 k = 4 wide-spread schedule; beta spread 9.0, a_alpha 4.0. The explicit heteroscedastic stress condition.

descendant_counts.note: 00 §11 k values an unknown-partner shared-source recovery can use. k = 1 is STRUCTURAL_NA: one observation cannot separate a common source from its residual.

reference_method.value: Spectral DeTuning — Recovering the Pre-Fine-Tuning Weights of Generative Models, ICML 2024, Algorithm 1 style
reference_method.note: Traceability only. The mathematics is implemented independently; no external source code was copied, and the study uses it as an occupied/reproduction baseline rather than a novel algorithm.

o3_recovery_authorization.note: 00 §24A.7. O3 recovery is implemented because it is pre-registered; implementation existence is not experiment authorization, and no O3 gate has been evaluated.

dare_incomplete_recovery_status.note: No incomplete-lineage DARE recovery method is implemented at S08.

hidden_alpha_recovery_status.note: 00 §25 authorises known-coefficient regimes only. Unknown partner plus unknown coefficient is refused rather than approximated.

naive_unrescaled_assumed_alpha.note: 00 §25 names the NAIVE_UNRESCALED_FIXED_ALPHA comparator but freezes no coefficient-estimation rule. The comparator therefore requires a predeclared assumed alpha supplied per cell by S09; reading a default here fails closed, so no coefficient inference can be invented.

fixture_residual_rank.note: Deterministic S08 fixture solves only. Not a research rank.

fixture_n_iters.note: Deterministic S08 fixture solves only, so parametrised tests stay fast. The production count is c2_n_iters.
